page_title: RBL 2-0 HEI | RB Leipzig v Heidenheim 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) as his effort only hit the wall.
90+2' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) jumps into a tackle and Frank Willenborg signals a foul. RB Leipzig are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+1' Substitution. Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) in, Ridle Baku out.
90+1' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
87' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christoph Baumgartner as he is replaced by Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig).
85' Here is a change. Romulo Cardoso is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Lois Openda (RB Leipzig).
82' The attendance for today's match is 43495.
78' 2 - 0 GOAL! Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Ridle Baku provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 2:0.
77' Here comes a substitution. Mathias Honsak is given a rest as he is replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).

74' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the right side of the goal, but great anticipation by Peter Gulacsi allowed him to make a comfortable save.
70' CLOSE! Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
68' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Luca Kerber and he is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
68' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
67' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) replacing Johan Bakayoko.
67' A substitution has been made. Ezechiel Banzuzi goes off and Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) comes on.
66' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
65' RB Leipzig get a corner.
65' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
64' 3:3 – the corner kicks stats.
62' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
62' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
61' David Raum (RB Leipzig) picks up a yellow card.
59' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) picked up a yellow card from referee.
58' Substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) coming on for Niklas Dorsch.
57' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen is replaced by Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim).
55' The game is interrupted. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
54' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
51' RB Leipzig win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
51' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
48' 1 - 0 Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
44' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 3:6.
42' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
40' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

37' David Raum (RB Leipzig) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Diant Ramaj, who gets down to save.
36' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
35' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) makes a strong challenge and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
34' The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.

33' A fine pass finds Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Diant Ramaj reacts superbly to deny him. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
30' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.

30' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Diant Ramaj makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
28' RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
28' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and RB Leipzig manage to earn a corner.
27' A player from RB Leipzig commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
23' 64:36 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
20' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.
20' Now Heidenheim have a corner.
20' An attempted cross from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Heidenheim.
19' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is caught in the offside trap after the defenders step up as one at the very right moment.

13' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Peter Gulacsi easily makes the save.
12' A rebound spins to Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
12' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Frank Willenborg who sees an offensive foul.
9' The corner is flicked onto Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
9' The referee points to the corner flag and Heidenheim will take a corner.

8' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Peter Gulacsi is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Heidenheim.

5' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
3' PENALTY APPEAL after Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
2' RB Leipzig hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Frank Willenborg is introduced as the referee for today's match.
